app_act_desc_letters.ha: Àwọn lẹ́tà. Níbí, a ó kọ́ àwọn lẹ́tà Gẹ̀ẹ́sì.
app_act_desc_letters.en: Letters. Here we learn the English letters.

app_act_desc_quiz.ha: Wá àwòrán. A ó sọ orúkọ nǹkan kan, lẹ́yìn náà, tẹ̀ àwòrán rẹ̀.
app_act_desc_quiz.en: Find the picture. The name of a thing will be said, then tap its picture.

app_act_desc_spell.ha: Ìkọ̀wé. Níbí, a ó kọ́ bí a ṣe ń kọ ọ̀rọ̀ Gẹ̀ẹ́sì, lẹ́tà kọ̀ọ̀kan.
app_act_desc_spell.en: Writing. Here we learn to write English words, letter by letter.

app_act_pick.ha: Yan ẹ̀kọ́ kan, láti gbọ́ nípa rẹ̀ sí i.
app_act_pick.en: Pick a lesson, to hear more about it.

app_book_start.ha: Láti bẹ̀rẹ̀, tẹ̀ ìwé tó wà lókè yìí, ká bẹ̀rẹ̀ ẹ̀kọ́.
app_book_start.en: To start, tap the book up here to begin learning.

app_book_more.ha: Tẹ̀ ìwé náà láti máa bá ẹ̀kọ́ lọ.
app_book_more.en: Tap the book to continue learning.

app_book_or.ha: O tún lè tẹ̀ ẹ̀kọ́ kan, láti gbọ́ nípa rẹ̀ sí i.
app_book_or.en: You can also press a lesson to hear more about it.

app_board_intro.ha: Gbogbo àwọn lẹ́tà nìyí. Jẹ́ ká kọ́ wọn ní ìpín-ìpín.
app_board_intro.en: Here are all the letters. Let's learn them group by group.

app_cat_desc_animals.ha: Ẹranko. Ẹ̀kọ́ yìí jẹ́ nípa oríṣiríṣi ẹranko tí ó ń gbé ní àyíká wa.
app_cat_desc_animals.en: Animals. This lesson is about the different animals that live around us.

app_cat_desc_body.ha: Ara. Ẹ̀kọ́ yìí jẹ́ nípa oríṣiríṣi ẹ̀yà ara ènìyàn.
app_cat_desc_body.en: The body. This lesson is about the different parts of the human body.

app_cat_desc_food.ha: Oúnjẹ. Ẹ̀kọ́ yìí jẹ́ nípa oríṣiríṣi oúnjẹ tí a ń jẹ lójoojúmọ́.
app_cat_desc_food.en: Food. This lesson is about the different foods we eat every day.

app_cat_desc_home.ha: Ohun èlò ilé. Ẹ̀kọ́ yìí jẹ́ nípa àwọn nǹkan tí a ń lò nínú ilé.
app_cat_desc_home.en: Household things. This lesson is about the things used at home.

app_cat_desc_nature.ha: Àyíká. Ẹ̀kọ́ yìí jẹ́ nípa àwọn nǹkan tí ó wà láyé àti ní àyíká wa.
app_cat_desc_nature.en: Nature. This lesson is about the things in nature and our surroundings.

app_cat_desc_vehicles.ha: Ọkọ̀. Ẹ̀kọ́ yìí jẹ́ nípa mọ́tò àti oríṣiríṣi ọkọ̀ tí a ń wọ̀.
app_cat_desc_vehicles.en: Vehicles. This lesson is about cars and the different things we ride.

app_cat_start_animals.ha: Báyìí, a ó wo àwọn àwòrán ẹranko. A ó kọ́ orúkọ wọn ní èdè Gẹ̀ẹ́sì.
app_cat_start_animals.en: Now we'll see pictures of animals. We'll learn their names in English.

app_cat_start_body.ha: Báyìí, a ó wo àwọn àwòrán ẹ̀yà ara. A ó kọ́ orúkọ wọn ní èdè Gẹ̀ẹ́sì.
app_cat_start_body.en: Now we'll see pictures of body parts. We'll learn their names in English.

app_cat_start_food.ha: Báyìí, a ó wo àwọn àwòrán oúnjẹ. A ó kọ́ orúkọ wọn ní èdè Gẹ̀ẹ́sì.
app_cat_start_food.en: Now we'll see pictures of food. We'll learn their names in English.

app_cat_start_home.ha: Báyìí, a ó wo àwọn àwòrán ohun èlò ilé. A ó kọ́ orúkọ wọn ní èdè Gẹ̀ẹ́sì.
app_cat_start_home.en: Now we'll see pictures of household things. We'll learn their names in English.

app_cat_start_nature.ha: Báyìí, a ó wo àwọn àwòrán nǹkan àyíká. A ó kọ́ orúkọ wọn ní èdè Gẹ̀ẹ́sì.
app_cat_start_nature.en: Now we'll see pictures of things in nature. We'll learn their names in English.

app_cat_start_numbers.ha: Báyìí, a ó kọ́ bí a ṣe ń kà nọ́mbà. A ó fi àwọn ìka ọwọ́ hàn ọ́. Kà àwọn ìka tí a gbé sókè, lẹ́yìn náà, sọ nọ́mbà náà ní èdè Gẹ̀ẹ́sì.
app_cat_start_numbers.en: Now we'll learn to count. Fingers will be shown. Count the fingers that are up, then say the number in English.

app_cat_start_vehicles.ha: Báyìí, a ó wo àwọn àwòrán ọkọ̀. A ó kọ́ orúkọ wọn ní èdè Gẹ̀ẹ́sì.
app_cat_start_vehicles.en: Now we'll see pictures of vehicles. We'll learn their names in English.

app_quiz_tap.ha: Tẹ̀ àwòrán nǹkan tí a dárúkọ.
app_quiz_tap.en: Tap the picture of the thing that was named.

app_quiz_wrong.ha: Rárá, kì í ṣe èyí. Tún fetí sílẹ̀, kí o sì tún gbìyànjú.
app_quiz_wrong.en: No, not that one. Listen again, try again.

app_read_good.ha: Ó dára gan-an! Báyìí, o ti lè kàwé!
app_read_good.en: Well done! Now you can read!

app_read_intro.ha: Ọ̀rọ̀ kan nìyí. A ó jọ kà ọ̀rọ̀ yìí. Lẹ́tà kọ̀ọ̀kan.
app_read_intro.en: Here is a word. We'll read this word together. Letter by letter.

app_read_word.ha: Báyìí, kà odindi ọ̀rọ̀ náà sókè.
app_read_word.en: Now read the whole word, out loud.

app_scatter_intro.ha: Báyìí, a ó da wọ́n pọ̀.

app_spell_intro.ha: Báyìí, kọ ọ́ ní èdè Gẹ̀ẹ́sì. Ọ̀nà méjì ló wà.
app_spell_intro.en: Now write it in English. There are two ways.

app_spell_ord_1.en: Tap or say the first letter.

app_spell_ord_2.en: Tap or say the second letter.

app_spell_ord_3.en: Tap or say the third letter.

app_spell_ord_4.en: Tap or say the fourth letter.

app_spell_ord_5.en: Tap or say the fifth letter.

app_spell_ord_6.en: Tap or say the sixth letter.

app_spell_ord_7.en: Tap or say the seventh letter.

app_spell_ord_8.en: Tap or say the eighth letter.

app_spell_ord_9.en: Tap or say the ninth letter.

app_spell_way_speak.ha: Tẹ̀ Fúnkẹ́, kí o sì sọ lẹ́tà náà.
app_spell_way_speak.en: Press Fúnkẹ́ and say the letter.

app_spell_way_tap.ha: Tàbí kí o tẹ̀ lẹ́tà èyíkéyìí.

app_stage_done.ha: Ó dára gan-an! O ti parí ìpín yìí.
app_stage_done.en: Well done! You've finished this group.

app_w_menu_intro.ha: Oríṣiríṣi ẹ̀kọ́ nìyí. Tẹ̀ àwòrán èyíkéyìí láti mọ̀ ohun tí ó wà nínú rẹ̀.
app_w_menu_intro.en: Here are the different lessons. Tap any picture to find out what's in it.

app_w_spell_test.ha: Báyìí, ìdánwò! Kọ ọ̀kọ̀ọ̀kan wọn, lẹ́tà kọ̀ọ̀kan.
app_w_spell_test.en: Now, a test! Write each one, letter by letter.

app_z_speak.ha: Nígbàkígbà tí o bá fẹ́ sọ̀rọ̀, tẹ̀ Fúnkẹ́. Màá fetí sílẹ̀ dáadáa!
app_z_speak.en: Whenever you want to speak, press Fúnkẹ́. I'll listen carefully!

s0.ha: Báwo ni! Bí o bá jẹ́ ọmọbìnrin, tẹ̀ èyí tí ó funfun. Bí o bá jẹ́ ọmọkùnrin, tẹ̀ èyí tí ó pupa.
s0.en: Hello! If you are a girl, tap the white one. If you are a boy, tap the red one.

s_abc_say.ha: Tẹ̀ Fúnkẹ́, lẹ́yìn náà, sọ lẹ́tà tí o rí.
s_abc_say.en: Press Fúnkẹ́, then say the letter you see.

s_act_desc_things.ha: Àwọn nǹkan. Níbí, a ó kọ́ orúkọ àwọn nǹkan ní èdè Gẹ̀ẹ́sì, pẹ̀lú àwòrán.
s_act_desc_things.en: Things. Here we learn the names of things in English, with pictures.

s_all_done.ha: Ó dára gan-an! Báyìí, o ti mọ̀ gbogbo lẹ́tà àti ọ̀rọ̀.
s_all_done.en: Well done! Now you know all the letters and words.

s_alone2.ha: Ẹnìkan wà lẹ́gbẹ̀ẹ́ rẹ. Jọ̀ọ́, jókòó ní ìwọ nìkan níwájú kámẹ́rà.
s_alone2.en: There is someone next to you. Please sit alone in front of the camera.

s_back_m.ha: Láti padà sẹ́yìn, tẹ̀ ilẹ̀kùn yìí.

s_back_f.ha: Láti padà sẹ́yìn, tẹ̀ ilẹ̀kùn yìí.

s_cat_desc_actions.ha: Iṣẹ́. Ẹ̀kọ́ yìí jẹ́ nípa àwọn nǹkan tí a ń ṣe lójoojúmọ́. Bí jíjẹ, mímu, sísáré àti ṣíṣeré.
s_cat_desc_actions.en: Actions. This lesson is about the things we do every day. Like eating, drinking, running and playing.

s_cat_desc_clothing.ha: Aṣọ. Ẹ̀kọ́ yìí jẹ́ nípa àwọn aṣọ tí a ń wọ̀.
s_cat_desc_clothing.en: Clothing. This lesson is about the clothes we wear.

s_cat_desc_people.ha: Ènìyàn. Ẹ̀kọ́ yìí jẹ́ nípa àwọn ènìyàn tí ó yí wa ká. Màmá, bàbá, àwọn ọmọdé àti àwọn olùkọ́.
s_cat_desc_people.en: People. This lesson is about the people around us. Mum, dad, children and teachers.

s_cat_desc_school.ha: Ilé-ìwé. Ẹ̀kọ́ yìí jẹ́ nípa àwọn ohun èlò ilé-ìwé tí a ń lò.
s_cat_desc_school.en: School. This lesson is about the things we use at school.

s_cat_start_actions.ha: Báyìí, a ó wo àwọn àwòrán iṣẹ́. A ó kọ́ orúkọ wọn ní èdè Gẹ̀ẹ́sì.
s_cat_start_actions.en: Now we'll see pictures of actions. We'll learn their names in English.

s_cat_start_clothing.ha: Báyìí, a ó wo àwọn àwòrán aṣọ. A ó kọ́ orúkọ wọn ní èdè Gẹ̀ẹ́sì.
s_cat_start_clothing.en: Now we'll see pictures of clothes. We'll learn their names in English.

s_cat_start_people.ha: Báyìí, a ó wo àwọn àwòrán ènìyàn. A ó kọ́ orúkọ wọn ní èdè Gẹ̀ẹ́sì.
s_cat_start_people.en: Now we'll see pictures of people. We'll learn their names in English.

s_cat_start_school.ha: Báyìí, a ó wo àwọn àwòrán ohun èlò ilé-ìwé. A ó kọ́ orúkọ wọn ní èdè Gẹ̀ẹ́sì.
s_cat_start_school.en: Now we'll see pictures of school things. We'll learn their names in English.

s_ear.ha: Láti tún gbọ́ ọ, tẹ̀ etí yìí.
s_ear.en: To hear it again, press this ear.

s_go.en: Now press Fúnkẹ́ and we'll start.

s_k_intro2.ha: Kíkà. Níbí, a ó kà àwọn ọ̀rọ̀, lẹ́tà kọ̀ọ̀kan, lẹ́yìn náà, gbogbo rẹ̀ papọ̀.
s_k_intro2.en: Reading. Here we read words, letter by letter, then all at once.

s_k_lesson.ha: Báyìí, a ó kà orúkọ àwọn nǹkan wọ̀nyí ní èdè Gẹ̀ẹ́sì.
s_k_lesson.en: Now we'll read the names of these things in English.

s_k_test.ha: Báyìí, a ó ṣe ìdánwò kékeré lórí àwọn ọ̀rọ̀ tí o ti kọ́. A ó fi ọ̀rọ̀ kan hàn ọ́, kí o sì kà á lódindi.
s_k_test.en: Now we'll do a small test on the words you learned. A word will be shown, and you read it whole.

s_kd_k3.ha: Ọ̀rọ̀ kúkúrú. Níbí, a ó kà àwọn ọ̀rọ̀ kúkúrú, tí ó ní lẹ́tà mẹ́ta.
s_kd_k3.en: Short words. Here we read short, three-letter words.

s_kd_k45.ha: Ọ̀rọ̀ alábọ́dé. Níbí, a ó kà àwọn ọ̀rọ̀ tí ó ní lẹ́tà mẹ́rin àti márùn-ún.
s_kd_k45.en: Medium words. Here we read four- and five-letter words.

s_kd_klong.ha: Ọ̀rọ̀ gígùn. Níbí, a ó kà àwọn ọ̀rọ̀ gígùn.
s_kd_klong.en: Long words. Here we read long words.

s_kd_knum.ha: Nọ́mbà. Níbí, a ó kà orúkọ àwọn nọ́mbà ní èdè Gẹ̀ẹ́sì.
s_kd_knum.en: Numbers. Here we read the names of numbers in English.

s_l_check.ha: Báyìí, a ó ṣe ìdánwò kékeré, láti rí i dájú pé o mọ̀ àwọn lẹ́tà tí o ti kọ́.
s_l_check.en: Now we'll do a small test, to make sure you understood the letters you learned.

s_l_final1.ha: Ìdánwò ńlá. Sọ gbogbo àwọn lẹ́tà, ọ̀kan lẹ́yìn èkejì.
s_l_final1.en: The big test. Say all the letters, one after another.

s_l_final2.ha: Ìdánwò ìkẹyìn. A ó da àwọn lẹ́tà pọ̀, a ó sì fi wọ́n hàn ọ́. Sọ gbogbo wọn.
s_l_final2.en: The last test. The letters will be shown mixed up; say them all.

s_l_look.ha: Lẹ́tà mẹ́rin nìyí. Fetí sílẹ̀, kí o sì wò wọ́n.
s_l_look.en: Here are four letters. Listen and look.

s_l_new2.ha: Báyìí, wàá rí lẹ́tà tuntun méjì láti kọ́. Ìpele tuntun nìyí. Ó ṣe pàtàkì gan-an.
s_l_new2.en: Now you'll see two new letters to learn. This is a new stage, a very important one.

s_l_new4.ha: Báyìí, wàá rí lẹ́tà tuntun mẹ́rin láti kọ́. Ìpele tuntun nìyí. Ó ṣe pàtàkì gan-an.
s_l_new4.en: Now you'll see four new letters to learn. This is a new stage, a very important one.

s_laila2.ha: Orúkọ mi ni Fúnkẹ́. Èmi ni ọ̀rẹ́ ẹ̀kọ́ rẹ. Báyìí, tẹ̀ orí mi, ká bẹ̀rẹ̀.
s_laila2.en: My name is Fúnkẹ́. I'm your learning friend. Now press my head and we'll start.

s_leave.ha: A fẹ́ parí ẹ̀kọ́ yìí. Bí o bá ti parí, tẹ̀ Fúnkẹ́. Bí bẹ́ẹ̀ kọ́, tẹ̀ pátákó dúdú.
s_leave.en: The session will end. If you are done, press Fúnkẹ́. If not, press the black slate.

s_loading.ha: Jọ̀ọ́, dúró díẹ̀. A ń ṣètò gbogbo nǹkan.
s_loading.en: Please wait a little. Everything is getting ready.

s_n_big.ha: Báyìí, ìdánwò ńlá! A ó dán gbogbo nọ́mbà tí o ti kọ́ wò, láti rí i dájú pé o mọ̀ wọ́n. A ó fi nọ́mbà kan hàn ọ́, a ó sọ orúkọ rẹ̀ ní èdè Yorùbá, ìwọ yóò sì sọ orúkọ rẹ̀ ní èdè Gẹ̀ẹ́sì. Bí o bá ti gbàgbé orúkọ rẹ̀ ní èdè Gẹ̀ẹ́sì,
s_n_big.en: Now the big test! We'll test all the numbers you learned, to make sure you know them. A number will be shown, its name said in Yoruba, and you say its name in English. If you've forgotten its English name,

s_n_focus5.ha: Báyìí, a ó tún kọ́ àwọn tí ó ṣòro fún ọ, pẹ̀lú díẹ̀ lára àwọn tí o mọ̀, láti túbọ̀ dánrawò.
s_n_focus5.en: Now we'll learn again the ones you struggled with, together with a few you know, for extra practice.

s_n_hundreds.ha: Báyìí, àwọn ọgọ́rọ̀ọ̀rún: igba, ọ̀ọ́dúnrún, títí dé ẹ̀ẹ́dẹ́gbẹ̀rún, lẹ́yìn náà, ẹgbẹ̀rún.
s_n_hundreds.en: Now the hundreds: two hundred, three hundred, up to nine hundred, then a thousand.

s_n_intro.ha: Níbí, a ó kọ́ nọ́mbà. Lákọ̀ọ́kọ́, a ó fi ìka ọwọ́ kà, láti ọ̀kan dé mẹ́wàá. Lẹ́yìn náà, a ó kọ́ àmì àwọn nọ́mbà.
s_n_intro.en: Here we learn numbers. First we count on our fingers, one to ten. Then we learn the number signs.

s_n_palms.ha: Ọwọ́ nìyí. Kà àwọn ìka tí a gbé sókè.
s_n_palms.en: Here is a hand. Count the fingers that are up.

s_n_sym2.ha: Báyìí, àmì àwọn nọ́mbà láti mọ́kànlá dé ogún.
s_n_sym2.en: Now the number signs from eleven to twenty.

s_n_symbols.ha: Báyìí, a ó kọ́ àmì àwọn nọ́mbà tí o ti kọ́, láti ọ̀kan dé mẹ́wàá.
s_n_symbols.en: Now we'll learn the signs of the numbers you learned, one to ten.

s_n_tens.ha: Báyìí, a ó kọ́ àwọn nọ́mbà ńlá: ọgbọ̀n, ogójì, àádọ́ta, títí dé ọgọ́rùn-ún.
s_n_tens.en: Now we'll learn the big numbers: thirty, forty, fifty, up to a hundred.

s_o_again2.ha: Tún fetí sílẹ̀. Ní èdè Gẹ̀ẹ́sì, a ń pè é ní:
s_o_again2.en: Listen again. In English, it is:

s_o_allright.ha: O ṣe gbogbo rẹ̀ dáadáa! Báyìí, jẹ́ ká tẹ̀síwájú.
s_o_allright.en: You got them all right! Now we go on.

s_o_focus_m.ha: Àwọn àwòrán tí wàá rí báyìí ni àwọn tí ó ṣòro fún ọ. A ó tún wọn kọ́.
s_o_focus_m.en: The pictures you'll see now are the ones you struggled with. We'll learn them again.

s_o_focus_f.ha: Àwọn àwòrán tí wàá rí báyìí ni àwọn tí ó ṣòro fún ọ. A ó tún wọn kọ́.
s_o_focus_f.en: The pictures you'll see now are the ones you struggled with. We'll learn them again.

s_o_focus.ha: Jẹ́ ká tún àwọn wọ̀nyí kọ́.
s_o_focus.en: The pictures you'll see now are the ones you struggled with. We'll learn them again.

s_o_inen.ha: Ní èdè Gẹ̀ẹ́sì, a ń pè é ní:

s_o_look.ha: Àwọn àwòrán nìyí. Fetí sílẹ̀, kí o sì wò wọ́n.
s_o_look.en: Here are three pictures. Listen and look.

s_o_miss.ha: Ìyẹn kò tọ̀nà. Jẹ́ ká tẹ̀síwájú.
s_o_miss.en: That one wasn't right. Let's go on.

s_o_new3.en: Now here are five more pictures.

s_o_next.ha: Báyìí, jẹ́ ká lọ sí èyí tí ó kàn.

s_o_retake.ha: Àwọn kan kò tọ̀nà. A ó tún wọn kọ́, lẹ́yìn náà, a ó tún ìdánwò náà ṣe.
s_o_retake.en: Some weren't right. We'll learn them again, then take the test again.

s_o_right.ha: Àwọn tí o mọ̀ dáadáa nìyí:
s_o_right.en: Here are the ones you got right:

s_o_test2.ha: Báyìí, a ó ṣe ìdánwò kékeré, láti rí i dájú pé o mọ̀ wọ́n. A ó fi àwòrán kan hàn ọ́, a ó sọ orúkọ rẹ̀ ní èdè Yorùbá, ìwọ yóò sì sọ orúkọ rẹ̀ ní èdè Gẹ̀ẹ́sì. Bí o bá ti gbàgbé orúkọ rẹ̀ ní èdè Gẹ̀ẹ́sì,
s_o_test2.en: Now we'll do a small test, to make sure you know them. A picture will be shown, its name said in Yoruba, and you say its name in English. If you've forgotten its English name,

s_o_three.ha: Ìyẹn ṣòro. Báyìí, jẹ́ ká lọ sí èyí tí ó kàn.
s_o_three.en: That one is hard. Now, on to the next.

s_o_turn.ha: Ó kàn ọ́. Tẹ̀ Fúnkẹ́, kí o sì sọ orúkọ rẹ̀ ní èdè Gẹ̀ẹ́sì.
s_o_turn.en: Your turn. Press Fúnkẹ́ and say its name in English.

s_o_wrong.ha: Àwọn wọ̀nyí náà, a ó tún wọn kọ́:

s_p1_m.ha: A ó ya fídíò rẹ bí o ṣe ń sọ orúkọ rẹ. Bí àpẹẹrẹ, bí orúkọ rẹ bá jẹ́ Báyọ̀, sọ pé: Orúkọ mi ni Báyọ̀.
s_p1_m.en: We will take a video of you saying your name. For example, if your name is Bayo, say: Orúkọ mi ni Bayo.

s_p1_f.ha: A ó ya fídíò rẹ bí o ṣe ń sọ orúkọ rẹ. Bí àpẹẹrẹ, bí orúkọ rẹ bá jẹ́ Fúnkẹ́, sọ pé: Orúkọ mi ni Fúnkẹ́.
s_p1_f.en: We will take a video of you saying your name. For example, if your name is Bayo, say: Orúkọ mi ni Bayo.

s_p2.ha: Ọmọkùnrin kan nìyí, Báyọ̀. Ó ń sọ orúkọ rẹ̀.
s_p2.en: Here is the boy Bayo / the girl Funke, saying the name.

s_p2_f.ha: Ọmọbìnrin kan nìyí, Fúnkẹ́. Ó ń sọ orúkọ rẹ̀.
s_p2_f.en: Here is the boy Bayo / the girl Funke, saying the name.

s_p3.ha: Báyìí, ìwọ ni. Sọ orúkọ rẹ fún wa. Tẹ̀ Fúnkẹ́, lẹ́yìn náà, sọ orúkọ rẹ fún wa.
s_p3.en: Now you: press Fúnkẹ́, then say your name.

s_perm.ha: A nílò kámẹ́rà àti máíkì kí èyí lè ṣiṣẹ́. Tẹ̀ 'Allow'.
s_perm.en: We need the camera and the microphone for this to work. Tap 'Allow'.

s_perm_no.ha: A kò rí ìyọ̀ǹda gbà. Tún gbìyànjú, kí o sì tẹ̀ 'Allow'.
s_perm_no.en: Permission was not given. Try again and tap 'Allow'.

s_q_again.ha: Báyìí, jẹ́ ká tún gbìyànjú, pẹ̀lú àwọn tuntun. Fetí sílẹ̀ dáadáa.
s_q_again.en: Now let's play again, with new ones. Listen carefully.

s_qd_q4.ha: Àwòrán mẹ́rin. A ó fi àwòrán mẹ́rin hàn ọ́, a ó sọ orúkọ ọ̀kan ní èdè Gẹ̀ẹ́sì, kí o sì tẹ̀ ẹ́.
s_qd_q4.en: Four pictures. You'll see four pictures, one will be named in English, and you tap it.

s_qd_qnum.ha: Nọ́mbà. A ó sọ nọ́mbà kan ní èdè Gẹ̀ẹ́sì, kí o sì tẹ̀ àmì rẹ̀.
s_qd_qnum.en: Numbers. A number will be said in English, and you tap its sign.

s_qn_tap.ha: Tẹ̀ àmì nọ́mbà tí a sọ.
s_qn_tap.en: Tap the sign of the number that was said.

s_r_intro2.ha: Níbí, a ó kọ́ bí a ṣe ń kọ orúkọ àwọn nǹkan ní èdè Gẹ̀ẹ́sì, lẹ́tà kọ̀ọ̀kan. A ó fi àwòrán kan hàn ọ́, kí o sì kọ orúkọ rẹ̀.
s_r_intro2.en: Here we learn to write the names of things in English, letter by letter. A picture will be shown, and you write its name.

s_r_turn.ha: Ó kàn ọ́. Yan ẹ̀kọ́ kan.

s_rd_r3.ha: Lẹ́tà mẹ́ta. Níbí, a ó kọ àwọn ọ̀rọ̀ tí ó ní lẹ́tà mẹ́ta, lẹ́tà kọ̀ọ̀kan.
s_rd_r3.en: Three letters. Here we write three-letter words, letter by letter.

s_rd_r4.ha: Lẹ́tà mẹ́rin. Níbí, a ó kọ àwọn ọ̀rọ̀ tí ó ní lẹ́tà mẹ́rin, lẹ́tà kọ̀ọ̀kan.
s_rd_r4.en: Four letters. Here we write four-letter words, letter by letter.

s_rd_r5.ha: Lẹ́tà márùn-ún. Níbí, a ó kọ àwọn ọ̀rọ̀ tí ó ní lẹ́tà márùn-ún, lẹ́tà kọ̀ọ̀kan.
s_rd_r5.en: Five letters. Here we write five-letter words, letter by letter.

s_rd_rlong.ha: Ọ̀rọ̀ gígùn. Níbí, a ó kọ àwọn ọ̀rọ̀ gígùn, lẹ́tà kọ̀ọ̀kan.
s_rd_rlong.en: Long words. Here we write long words, letter by letter.

s_rd_rnum.ha: Nọ́mbà. Níbí, a ó kọ orúkọ àwọn nọ́mbà ní èdè Gẹ̀ẹ́sì, lẹ́tà kọ̀ọ̀kan.
s_rd_rnum.en: Numbers. Here we write the names of numbers in English, letter by letter.

s_retry_face.ha: N kò rí ọ dáadáa. Jọ̀ọ́, jẹ́ ká tún gbìyànjú.
s_retry_face.en: I can't see you well. Please, let's try again.

s_retry_name.ha: N kò gbọ́ orúkọ rẹ dáadáa. Jọ̀ọ́, jẹ́ ká tún gbìyànjú.
s_retry_name.en: I couldn't hear you say your name. Please, let's try again.

s_retry_door.ha: Tàbí kí o tẹ̀ ilẹ̀kùn yìí láti padà sí ìbẹ̀rẹ̀.
s_retry_door.en: Or click this door to go back and start again.

s_sp_spelt.ha: Báyìí ni a ṣe ń kọ ọ́:

sx_intro.ha: Àpẹẹrẹ! Wò ó, kí o sì gbọ́ bí a ṣe ń ṣe é.
sx_intro.en: Example! Watch and listen to how it's done.

sx_k_letters.ha: Èmi ni màá kà àwọn lẹ́tà náà, ọ̀kan lẹ́yìn èkejì. Fetí sílẹ̀.
sx_k_letters.en: I will read the letters, one by one. Listen.

s_w_name.ha: Orúkọ mi ni Fúnkẹ́. Èmi ni ọ̀rẹ́ ẹ̀kọ́ rẹ.
s_w_name.en: My name is Fúnkẹ́. I am your learning friend.

s_w_together.ha: Papọ̀, a ó kọ́ èdè Gẹ̀ẹ́sì.
s_w_together.en: Together we are going to learn English.

s_w_have.ha: Mo ní àwọn ẹ̀kọ́ tí ó dára gan-an.

s_w_l1.ha: A ó kọ́ àwọn lẹ́tà Gẹ̀ẹ́sì.
s_w_l1.en: We will learn the English alphabet.

s_w_l2.ha: A ó kọ́ bí a ṣe ń kàwé àti bí a ṣe ń kọ̀wé ní èdè Gẹ̀ẹ́sì.
s_w_l2.en: We will learn to read and write in English.

s_w_l3.ha: A ó kọ́ bí a ṣe ń kà nọ́mbà.

s_w_l4.ha: A ó kọ́ orúkọ àwọn nǹkan, bí ẹranko àti oúnjẹ, ní èdè Gẹ̀ẹ́sì.
s_w_l4.en: We will learn the names of things like animals and foods, in English.

s_w_more.ha: Àti ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ nǹkan mìíràn tí ó dùn mọ́ni.

s_w_talk.ha: Wàá lè bá mi sọ̀rọ̀. Màá wà pẹ̀lú rẹ.
s_w_talk.en: You will be able to speak to me and I will be with you.

s_b_glad.ha: Inú mi dùn láti rí ọ.
s_b_glad.en: I am happy to see you.

s_b_cont.ha: Báyìí, jẹ́ ká tẹ̀síwájú láti ibi tí a dúró sí.
s_b_cont.en: Now let us continue from where we stopped.

sx_do_say.ha: Ohun tí wàá ṣe láti sọ ọ́ ní èdè Gẹ̀ẹ́sì nìyí. Wàá tẹ̀ Fúnkẹ́, lẹ́yìn náà, wàá sọ pé:
sx_do_say.en: Here is what you will do to say it in English. You will press Fúnkẹ́, then you will say:

sx_do_read.ha: Ohun tí wàá ṣe láti kà á ní èdè Gẹ̀ẹ́sì nìyí. Wàá tẹ̀ Fúnkẹ́, lẹ́yìn náà, wàá kà ọ̀rọ̀ náà:
sx_do_read.en: Here is what you will do to read it in English. You will press Fúnkẹ́, then you will read the word:

sx_do_spell.ha: Ohun tí wàá ṣe láti kọ ọ́ ní èdè Gẹ̀ẹ́sì nìyí. Wàá tẹ̀ Fúnkẹ́, lẹ́yìn náà, wàá sọ àwọn lẹ́tà náà:
sx_do_spell.en: Here is what you will do to write it in English. You will press Fúnkẹ́, then you will say the letters:

sx_do_find.ha: Ohun tí wàá ṣe nìyí. Fetí sílẹ̀, lẹ́yìn náà, tẹ̀ àwòrán tí a dárúkọ.
sx_do_find.en: Here is what you will do. Listen, then press the picture that was named.

sx_do_findnum.ha: Ohun tí wàá ṣe nìyí. Fetí sílẹ̀, lẹ́yìn náà, tẹ̀ nọ́mbà tí a dárúkọ.
sx_do_findnum.en: Here is what you will do. Listen, then press the number that was named.

s_q_start.ha: Báyìí, a ó fi àwòrán mẹ́rin hàn ọ́. Fetí sí orúkọ tí a sọ ní èdè Gẹ̀ẹ́sì, lẹ́yìn náà, tẹ̀ ẹ́.
s_q_start.en: Now you will be shown four pictures. Listen for the name said in English, then press it.

s_qn_start.ha: Báyìí, a ó fi àwọn nọ́mbà hàn ọ́. Fetí sí èyí tí a sọ ní èdè Gẹ̀ẹ́sì, lẹ́yìn náà, tẹ̀ ẹ́.
s_qn_start.en: Now you will be shown numbers. Listen for the one said in English, then press it.

sx_r_plan.ha: A ó sọ àwọn lẹ́tà náà, ọ̀kan lẹ́yìn èkejì. Ọ̀nà méjì ló wà.
sx_r_plan.en: We will say the letters one after another. There are two ways.

sx_r_v1.ha: Lẹ́tà àkọ́kọ́, màá fi ohùn mi sọ ọ́.
sx_r_v1.en: The first letter, I will say with my voice.

sx_r_v2.ha: Lẹ́tà kejì náà, màá fi ohùn mi sọ ọ́.
sx_r_v2.en: The second letter too, I will say with my voice.

sx_r_kb.ha: Lẹ́tà ìkẹyìn ní tirẹ̀, màá tẹ̀ ẹ́ lórí pátákó.
sx_r_kb.en: And the last letter, I will press it on the board.

s_pop_intro.ha: Àwọn bàlúù tí ó ní lẹ́tà nìyí. Fi ìka rẹ tẹ̀ bàlúù kan, yóò sì bẹ́.
s_pop_intro.en: Here are balloons with letters. Press a balloon with your finger and it bursts.

s_pop_done.ha: Ó dára gan-an, a ti parí eré náà!
s_pop_done.en: Well done, we've finished the game!

s_pop_task.ha: Wá lẹ́tà àkọ́kọ́ ní èdè Gẹ̀ẹ́sì, kí o sì fọ́ ọ. Lẹ́yìn náà, lẹ́tà tí ó tẹ̀lé e, ní tẹ̀léntẹ̀lé.
s_pop_task.en: Find the first letter of English and pop it. Then the letter after it, in order.

s_gate_calm.ha: Má ṣe dààmú. Jẹ́ ká kọ́ wọn ná.
s_gate_calm.en: Don't worry. Let us learn them first.

s_gate_play.ha: A ó ṣe eré kékeré kan.
s_gate_play.en: We are going to play a little game.

s_gate_first.ha: A fẹ́ mọ̀ dájú pé o mọ àwọn lẹ́tà Gẹ̀ẹ́sì, bíi
s_gate_first.en: We want to make sure you know the English letters, like

s_gate_yes.ha: Bí o bá mọ̀ wọ́n, tẹ̀ Fúnkẹ́ láti bẹ̀rẹ̀.
s_gate_yes.en: If you know them, tap Fúnkẹ́ to begin.

s_gate_no.ha: Bí o kò bá mọ̀ wọ́n, kò burú, a ó jọ kọ́ wọn. Tẹ̀ pátákó dúdú láti bẹ̀rẹ̀ ẹ̀kọ́.
s_gate_no.en: If you don't, no problem, we will learn them together. Tap the black slate to begin learning.

s_g_fish_how.ha: Mú ẹja tó gbé ohun tí mo bá sọ.
s_g_fish_how.en: Catch the fish carrying the thing I say.

s_g_drum_how.ha: Wo àwòrán yìí. Tẹ̀ Fúnkẹ́, sọ orúkọ rẹ̀ ní Gẹ̀ẹ́sì, màá sì lu dùndún!
s_g_drum_how.en: Look at this picture. Tap Fúnkẹ́, say its name in English, and I will beat the dundun!

s_g_market_how.ha: Àwọn oníbàárà ti dé! Tètè fún ẹnìkọ̀ọ̀kan ní ohun tó béèrè.
s_g_market_how.en: The shoppers are here! Quickly give each one what they ask for.

s_g_canoes_how.ha: Ka ọ̀rọ̀ tó wà lára ọkọ̀ ojú omi kọ̀ọ̀kan, kí o sì tẹ èyí tó bá àwòrán mu. Ọkọ̀ yẹn yóò borí eré ìje!
s_g_canoes_how.en: Read the word on each canoe, then tap the one that matches the picture. That canoe will win the race!

s_g_pots_how.ha: Jẹ́ ká ta ayò! Tẹ àwọn kóró tó ní lẹ́tà ọ̀rọ̀ náà ní ọ̀kọ̀ọ̀kan, kí wọ́n bọ́ sínú ihò.
s_g_pots_how.en: Let's play ayo! Tap the seeds with the word's letters one after another, and they drop into the pits.

s_g_house_how.ha: Jẹ́ ká kọ́ ilé náà kí àkókò tó tán! Tẹ̀ Fúnkẹ́, kí o sì sọ àwọn lẹ́tà ọ̀rọ̀ náà ní ọ̀kọ̀ọ̀kan. Lẹ́tà kọ̀ọ̀kan jẹ́ bíríkì kan.
s_g_house_how.en: Let's build the house before time runs out! Tap Fúnkẹ́ and say the word's letters one by one. Every letter is a brick.

s_g_learn.ha: Kò burú! Jẹ́ ká jọ bẹ̀rẹ̀ ẹ̀kọ́. Tẹ̀ Fúnkẹ́ láti máa bá a lọ.
s_g_learn.en: No problem! Let's start learning together. Tap Fúnkẹ́ to continue.

s_g_go.ha: Tẹ̀ Fúnkẹ́ láti máa bá a lọ.

s_g_durbar_how.ha: Sọ lẹ́tà tó wà lórí àsíá ẹlẹ́ṣin náà, yóò sì kí Ọba!
s_g_durbar_how.en: Say the letter on the rider's banner, and he will greet the Oba!

s_g_durbar_eg1.ha: Bí eré yìí ṣe ń lọ nìyí: sọ lẹ́tà tí o rí lórí àsíá ẹlẹ́ṣin náà, kí inú Ọba lè dùn.
s_g_durbar_eg1.en: Here is how the game works: say the letter you see on the rider's banner, so the Oba is happy.

s_g_durbar_ready.en: Now press Fúnkẹ́ and we'll start.

s_g_dillali_how.ha: Sọ orúkọ nǹkan yìí ní Gẹ̀ẹ́sì, alàtẹ yóò sì tà á!
s_g_dillali_how.en: Say this thing's name in English, and the market caller will sell it!

s_g_shayi_how.ha: Oníbàárà ti dé! Wo ohun tí ó fẹ́, tẹ Fúnkẹ́, kí o sì sọ orúkọ rẹ̀ ní Gẹ̀ẹ́sì, Ìyá Àkàrà yóò sì fún un.
s_g_shayi_how.en: A customer is here! Look at what they want, press Fúnkẹ́ and say its name in English, and the akara seller will give it to them.

s_g_gyada_how.ha: Tẹ̀ òkìtì tí iye àpò kòkó rẹ̀ jẹ́ iye tí mo bá sọ.
s_g_gyada_how.en: Tap the stack with as many cocoa sacks as the number I say.

s_g_shanu_how.ha: Tẹ̀ èyí tí iye owó rẹ̀ bá ohun tí mo sọ mu.
s_g_shanu_how.en: Tap the one whose price matches what I say.

s_g_garke_how.ha: Ka àwọn màlúù tó wà nínú ọgbà, kí o sì sọ iye wọn ní Gẹ̀ẹ́sì.
s_g_garke_how.en: Count the cows in the pen and say how many in English.

s_g_garke_eg1.ha: Bí eré yìí ṣe ń lọ nìyí: ka àwọn màlúù tó wà nínú ọgbà, lẹ́yìn náà sọ iye wọn ní Gẹ̀ẹ́sì.
s_g_garke_eg1.en: Here is how the game works: count the cows in the pen, then say how many in English.

s_g_suya_how.ha: Sọ iye owó tó wà lọ́wọ́ rẹ ní Gẹ̀ẹ́sì, kí o sì san owó fún ẹni tó ń ta bọ̀lì.
s_g_suya_how.en: Say the money in your hand in English, and pay the boli seller.

s_g_allo_how.ha: Ka ọ̀rọ̀ tó wà lórí ìlẹ̀kùn sókè, gbẹ́nàgbẹ́nà yóò sì gbẹ́ ẹ.
s_g_allo_how.en: Read the word on the door out loud, and the carver will carve it.

s_g_jirgi_how.ha: Ka ọ̀rọ̀ tó wà lára ọkọ̀ náà sókè, yóò sì dé etí omi.
s_g_jirgi_how.en: Read the word on the boat out loud, and it will come to the bank.

s_g_marubuci_how.ha: Sọ àwọn lẹ́tà ọ̀rọ̀ náà ní ọ̀kọ̀ọ̀kan, tàbí kí o tẹ̀ wọ́n lórí pátákó ìtẹ̀wé, akọ̀wé lẹ́tà yóò sì kọ wọ́n.
s_g_marubuci_how.en: Say the letters of the word one by one, or press them on the keyboard, and the letter writer will write them.

s_g_ruwa_how.ha: Ka ọ̀rọ̀ tó wà lórí ìkùukùu sókè, òjò yóò sì rọ̀ sórí oko.
s_g_ruwa_how.en: Read the word on the cloud out loud, and the rain will fall on the farm.

s_g_rini_how.ha: Sọ àwọn lẹ́tà ọ̀rọ̀ náà ní ọ̀kọ̀ọ̀kan, tàbí kí o tẹ̀ wọ́n lórí pátákó ìtẹ̀wé, aláró yóò sì pa aṣọ náà láró.
s_g_rini_how.en: Say the letters of the word one by one, or press them on the keyboard, and the dyer will dye the cloth.

s_l_game.ha: Báyìí, jẹ́ ká ṣe eré kan pẹ̀lú àwọn lẹ́tà tí o ti kọ́!
s_l_game.en: Now let's play a game with the letters you've learned!

s_pop_again.ha: O ti fẹ́rẹ̀ ẹ́ ṣe é! Jẹ́ ká tún gbìyànjú lẹ́ẹ̀kan sí i.
s_pop_again.en: You were close! Let's try once more.

s_game_open.ha: Báyìí, o lè ṣe eré yìí nígbàkígbà tí o bá fẹ́, láti ojú-ìwé àkọ́kọ́.
s_game_open.en: Now you can play this game whenever you like, from the home page.

s_z_got_3_50.ha: O ṣe dáadáa! O ti gba ìràwọ̀ mẹ́ta àti wúrà àádọ́ta.
s_z_got_3_50.en: Well done! You earned three stars and 50 gold.

s_z_got_3_100.ha: O ṣe dáadáa! O ti gba ìràwọ̀ mẹ́ta àti wúrà ọgọ́rùn-ún.
s_z_got_3_100.en: Well done! You earned three stars and 100 gold.

s_z_got_3_150.ha: O ṣe dáadáa! O ti gba ìràwọ̀ mẹ́ta àti wúrà àádọ́jọ.
s_z_got_3_150.en: Well done! You earned three stars and 150 gold.

s_z_got_3_200.ha: O ṣe dáadáa! O ti gba ìràwọ̀ mẹ́ta àti wúrà igba.
s_z_got_3_200.en: Well done! You earned three stars and 200 gold.

s_z_got_4_50.ha: O ṣe dáadáa! O ti gba ìràwọ̀ mẹ́rin àti wúrà àádọ́ta.
s_z_got_4_50.en: Well done! You earned four stars and 50 gold.

s_z_got_4_100.ha: O ṣe dáadáa! O ti gba ìràwọ̀ mẹ́rin àti wúrà ọgọ́rùn-ún.
s_z_got_4_100.en: Well done! You earned four stars and 100 gold.

s_z_got_4_150.ha: O ṣe dáadáa! O ti gba ìràwọ̀ mẹ́rin àti wúrà àádọ́jọ.
s_z_got_4_150.en: Well done! You earned four stars and 150 gold.

s_z_got_4_200.ha: O ṣe dáadáa! O ti gba ìràwọ̀ mẹ́rin àti wúrà igba.
s_z_got_4_200.en: Well done! You earned four stars and 200 gold.

s_z_now_fada.ha: Báyìí, o ti di Ọmọ Ààfin!
s_z_now_fada.en: Now you are a Ọmọ Ààfin!

s_z_now_dansarki.ha: Báyìí, o ti di Ọmọ Ọba!
s_z_now_dansarki.en: Now you are a Ọmọ Ọba!

s_z_effort.ha: Akitiyan rẹ ti mú ọ dé ipò tuntun!
s_z_effort.en: Your effort has brought you to a new level!

s_z_bag1.ha: Àpò wúrà rẹ àkọ́kọ́ ti kún!
s_z_bag1.en: Your first bag of gold is full!

s_z_bag2.ha: Àpò wúrà rẹ kejì ti kún!
s_z_bag2.en: Your second bag of gold is full!

s_z_bag3.ha: Àpò wúrà rẹ kẹta ti kún!
s_z_bag3.en: Your third bag of gold is full!

s_z_bag4.ha: Àpò wúrà rẹ kẹrin ti kún!
s_z_bag4.en: Your fourth bag of gold is full!

s_z_bag5.ha: Àpò wúrà rẹ karùn-ún ti kún!
s_z_bag5.en: Your fifth bag of gold is full!

s_z_gold_1000.ha: Wúrà rẹ ti tó ẹgbẹ̀rún kan.

s_z_gold_2000.ha: Wúrà rẹ ti tó ẹgbẹ̀rún méjì.

s_z_gold_4000.ha: Wúrà rẹ ti tó ẹgbẹ̀rún mẹ́rin.

s_z_gold_6000.ha: Wúrà rẹ ti tó ẹgbẹ̀rún mẹ́fà.

s_z_gold_8000.ha: Wúrà rẹ ti tó ẹgbẹ̀rún mẹ́jọ.

s_z_gold_10000.ha: Wúrà rẹ ti tó ẹgbẹ̀rún mẹ́wàá.

s_z_gold_12000.ha: Wúrà rẹ ti tó ẹgbẹ̀rún méjìlá.

s_z_gold_16000.ha: Wúrà rẹ ti tó ẹgbẹ̀rún mẹ́rìndínlógún.

s_z_first.ha: Èyí ni ipò àkọ́kọ́. Ipò mẹ́rin mìíràn ṣì wà níwájú.
s_z_first.en: This is the first level. There are four more levels ahead.

s_z_keep_first.ha: Máa gbìyànjú, títí o fi máa di Ọba!
s_z_keep_first.en: Keep trying, until you become an Oba!

s_z_keep.en: Keep up the effort like this!

s_z_top.ha: Èyí ni ipò tó ga jùlọ!
s_z_top.en: This is the highest level of all!
